newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish NBP buys dollars at PLN 3.0531 - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Polish NBP buys dollars at PLN 3.0531 - dealers.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland (NBP) again bought dollars on the interbank forex market, this time at 3.0531 zlotys, dealers said.

The intervention, described as "medium," came at 1240 GMT when the zloty was at 2.83 percent from Wednesday's average weighted dollar and mark parity rates, the centre of the daily 14-percent trading band.
Earlier, the NBP bought dollars at several other levels, with the latest round of intervention at 3.0486 zlotys. It also bought marks at 1.8040 zlotys. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
